name: Plastic Molding Technology - El Paso
description: Plastic Molding Technology (PMT) is a plastics manufacturer listed in El Paso, Texas, that operates four sites in the Mountain time zone. Its core processes are injection molding, thermoforming and extrusion. The company performs insert molding and overmolding with robotic automation cells, vertical presses and rotary tables, as well as heavy-gauge thermoforming and vacuum forming. Mold design, mold building and repair are done in-house, and 3D printing and CNC machining support prototyping. PMT holds IATF 16949 certification as a supplier to Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive manufacturers and keeps ISO 13485 compliance for medical work. Markets include aerospace, communications, energy and industrial customers.
